summary: An arpeggiator that works on note wires: it takes the notes you hold (or a chord from another note machine) and sends them on one at a time, in time with the song. Twelve patterns (up, down, up-down, converge, diverge, as played, random, random walk, a whole chord, or your own 16-step row with ties, accents and a transpose per step), a rate from 1/1 to 1/64 with dotted and triplet or a free time in milliseconds, swing, gate, one to four octaves, repeats, velocity, humanize and a latch. It makes no sound itself: put it before a synth as a note insert, or on a note wire to any machine that takes notes. Use it for arpeggios, rhythmic chord stabs, basslines and sequenced leads.
use_for: Turn held notes into an arpeggio or a stepped line before any synth: 12 patterns, 1/1 to 1/64 or ms rates, swing, gate, octaves, latch and a 16-step row with ties and accents.

parameters.name: Pattern
parameters.description: The order the held notes are played in
parameters.how: Chooses the order the held notes are played in: up, down, back and forth, from the outside in or the inside out, as you played them, at random, as a walk, all together as a chord, or by your own step row.
parameters.sound: Up and Down make runs, Up-down a wave, Converge and Diverge a pinch or a bloom, Random a sparkle, Chord a rhythmic pulse and Steps a sequenced line.

parameters.name: Octaves
parameters.description: How many octaves the pattern climbs through (1 … 4)
parameters.how: Plays the pattern again an octave higher, up to four octaves, in the order the Octave mode says.
parameters.sound: More octaves widen the run: a sweeping arpeggio instead of a close figure.

parameters.name: Octave mode
parameters.description: The order the octaves are visited in
parameters.how: Chooses whether each pass of the pattern goes up an octave, down an octave or up and back down.
parameters.sound: Up climbs away, Down falls toward the played notes, Up-down rises and returns.

parameters.name: Repeats
parameters.description: How many times each note is played before the next (1 … 4)
parameters.how: Plays each note of the pattern this many times in a row before moving on.
parameters.sound: Higher values make the figure stutter on each note: a pulsing, slower-moving arpeggio.

parameters.name: Transpose
parameters.description: Moves every note by semitones (−24 … +24)
parameters.how: Moves every note up or down by this many semitones.
parameters.sound: It shifts the whole arpeggio without changing the keys you hold.

parameters.name: Timing
parameters.description: Whether steps follow the song's tempo or run on a time in milliseconds
parameters.how: Chooses between steps locked to the song's tempo and position and steps of a fixed length in milliseconds.
parameters.sound: Song tempo keeps the arpeggio in time with the music; Free time runs at its own speed, whatever the tempo.

parameters.name: Rate
parameters.description: The length of a step at the song's tempo
parameters.how: Sets how long each step lasts at the song's tempo, from eight bars to a sixty-fourth.
parameters.sound: Shorter steps make a faster, busier arpeggio.

parameters.name: Feel
parameters.description: Straight, dotted (1.5 times as long), triplet (two thirds as long) or quintuplet (four fifths as long) steps
parameters.how: Makes the steps straight, dotted (one and a half times as long) triplet (two thirds as long) or quintuplet (four fifths as long).
parameters.sound: Dotted steps lilt against the beat; triplets make a rolling, three-against-two feel.

parameters.name: Free time
parameters.description: The length of a step in milliseconds when Timing is Free time (20 … 2000)
parameters.how: Sets the length of a step in milliseconds when Timing is Free time.
parameters.sound: Shorter times are faster; the pattern no longer follows the song's tempo.

parameters.name: Swing
parameters.description: Delays every second step by up to 75 % of a step
parameters.how: Delays every second step by a share of a step, up to 75 %.
parameters.sound: The arpeggio takes a shuffled, off-beat lilt.

parameters.name: Gate
parameters.description: How long each note lasts, as a share of a step (5 … 200 %)
parameters.how: Sets how long each note sounds as a share of one step; above 100 % the notes overlap.
parameters.sound: Low values are short and detached; 100 % just touches the next note; higher values run together, legato.

parameters.name: Velocity
parameters.description: Where the velocity of each note comes from
parameters.how: Chooses the velocity: as you played each key, one fixed value, or a fixed value with the accented steps louder.
parameters.sound: As played keeps your touch; Fixed makes every note equally loud; Accent makes the marked steps stand out.

parameters.name: Fixed velocity
parameters.description: The velocity of Fixed and Accent modes (1 … 127)
parameters.how: Sets the velocity used by the Fixed and Accent modes.
parameters.sound: Higher values play every note harder and brighter on most instruments.

parameters.name: Accent
parameters.description: How far an accented step rises above the fixed velocity, toward 127
parameters.how: Sets how far an accented step lifts the velocity from the fixed value toward 127 (Accent mode, Steps pattern).
parameters.sound: Higher values make the accented steps hit harder.

parameters.name: Humanize time
parameters.description: Random lateness of each note, up to this many milliseconds
parameters.how: Delays each note by a random time up to this many milliseconds, the same every time the song is played.
parameters.sound: A little looseness takes the machine-like edge off the pattern.

parameters.name: Humanize velocity
parameters.description: Random change of each note's velocity, up to this share
parameters.how: Changes each note's velocity by a random amount up to this share, the same every time the song is played.
parameters.sound: A little variation makes repeated notes feel played, not stamped.

parameters.name: Latch
parameters.description: Keeps the notes sounding after you let go, until you play a new chord
parameters.how: With Latch on, the notes stay in the arpeggio after release until a new chord is played.
parameters.sound: You can take your hands off and the arpeggio keeps going.

parameters.name: Retrigger
parameters.description: When the pattern starts over
parameters.how: Chooses when the pattern restarts: never (it follows the song position), on each new note, or on each bar line; steps always stay on the song's grid.
parameters.sound: Free running keeps the pattern in step with the song wherever you start; the others always begin the figure from its first note.

parameters.name: Step count
parameters.description: How many steps of the row the Steps pattern uses (1 … 16)
parameters.how: Sets how many of the 16 steps the Steps pattern plays before it starts over.
parameters.sound: Counts that do not divide the bar make the pattern drift against it.

parameters.name: Step 1
parameters.description: Step 1 of the row: Off, On, Tie (holds the note before it) or Accent
parameters.how: Sets what step 1 of the row does in the Steps pattern: rest (Off), play a note (On), hold the note before it (Tie) or play it louder (Accent).
parameters.sound: Ties lengthen a note across steps and accents make the marked steps stand out, which is what gives the row its rhythm.

parameters.name: Step 1 transpose
parameters.description: Step 1's transpose in semitones (−12 … +12)
parameters.how: Moves the note step 1 plays by this many semitones, up or down, in the Steps pattern.
parameters.sound: Steps moved up or down make a melodic line, a leap or an octave jump, out of the held notes.
